title: Chat reply v2
description: Extends chat_reply.v1 with kind = 'open': fluid, model-generated prose from the v3 agent path (V3_ARCHITECTURE.md §2), verified post-generation (I1/I2) rather than assembled from a closed license template. 'answer'/'decline' keep v1's exact shape and semantics — this is additive, not a replacement. An 'open' reply carries `evidence` (the agent tool-registry's {source,id} refs, §4.2) instead of the closed-vocabulary `licenses` array, because an open reply is not selected from a fixed set of licensed relationship claims the way an 'answer' is.

licenses.description: Closed-vocabulary evidence (kind=answer/decline). Empty for kind=open — an open reply's evidence is `evidence`, not `licenses`.

evidence.description: Agent tool-registry evidence refs (§4.2) grounding an open reply. Required if and only if kind=open.
